description: photovoltaic module fault data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Li Shuo-han. "This dataset contains electrical and environmental measurements of photovoltaic (PV) modules operating under multiple fault conditions. It is designed to support research on PV fault diagnosis, performance analysis, and data-driven modeling under limited-sample and multi-condition scenarios. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
